channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Trump bans CNN, MSNOW, and Politico from White House: ‘Reporting FAKE NEWS’, ‘They write fiction and lies’
item.description: Trump made the announcement on his Truth Social platform and warned that other media outlets could face similar restrictions.

item.title: Iran war US casualties: Why Pentagon tally shows 18 while officials cite 22-23
item.description: The discrepancy centres on the Pentagon's Defense Casualty Analysis System (DCAS), the public database used to report US military deaths and injuries.

item.title: Iran War Drives Bigger Diesel Supply Loss Despite Trump’s Claims
item.description: Diesel prices have never been higher. US President Donald Trump contends that’s not because of the war he started nearly seven months ago.

item.title: Disney has hired veteran technology executive Karandeep Anand as its first chief technology officer: Who is he?
item.description: Disney has appointed Karandeep Anand as its first chief technology officer. The former Character AI CEO brings senior experience from Microsoft, Meta and Brex as Disney expands its focus on technology and AI.

item.title: Tamil Nadu gold ring for newborns: CM Vijay to launch scheme on Sep 28; 1.28L pieces ready for phase 1—check eligibility
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay will launch a scheme on September 28 offering one-gram gold rings to newborns, with 1.28 lakh rings initially purchased. The initiative is aimed at promoting child welfare and enhancing public trust in government healthcare services.

item.title: Amazon Prime users in US could get more cash as FTC makes key changes to $2.5bn settlement payments: Details here
item.description: Amazon will expand automatic refunds under its $2.5 billion FTC settlement, with millions more Prime users eligible from 1 October. The maximum total payment has risen to $200, with no claim form required.

item.title: US gas prices near 2026 peak with weeks to go before midterms
item.description: The national average for regular gasoline reached about $4.46 per gallon on Friday, according to the figures provided by AAA Gas Prices website, just 10 cents below the year's high of $4.56, recorded on May 21.

item.title: Asian Games 2026: Sports Ministry reaches out to Indian diaspora amid accommodation crisis in Nagoya
item.description: Sports Ministry reaches out to Indian diaspora to help deal with lodging crisis at Asiad

item.title: Mid-air brawl on Dhaka-London flight leaves passengers including kids panicked, Biman Bangladesh responds | Watch video
item.description: Chaos erupted in a Biman Bangladesh flight from London to Dhaka as two passengers engaged in a physical fight. A video of the incident has been shared by an eyewitness.

item.title: EIL eyes oil pipeline, storage projects in Saudi Arabia, UAE
item.description: Engineers India Ltd chairman and managing director Atul Gupta said the proposed pipeline projects in Saudi Arabia and the UAE could be worth around $1 billion, with a tentative gestation period of two-three years.

item.title: Social Security becomes Senate election flashpoint: 81% of voters prefer candidates who promise to prevent benefit cuts
item.description: The survey covered 2,500 registered voters across five states — Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio and Texas — where Senate races are being closely watched.

item.title: European age-verification app for children: What is it, how does it work & how does it differ from Australia? Explained
item.description: The European Commission proposed prohibiting children under 13 from using social media, while allowing those aged 13 to 15 to access platforms through accounts supervised by their parents. ‘Online platforms can easily rely on our age verification app,’ Ursula von der Leyen said.

item.title: Macron warns of growing Russian threat: How ‘hybrid attacks’ are targeting Europe
item.description: Hybrid warfare refers to the use of multiple methods—military and non-military, overt and covert—to pressure or destabilise another country without necessarily triggering a conventional armed conflict.

item.title: Sway DaSafo dies aged 44: Who was the British-Ghanaian rapper who made MOBO history as an unsigned artist?
item.description: British-Ghanaian rapper Sway DaSafo has died aged 44 at his home in Ghana. The MOBO-winning artist made history as an unsigned rapper and later found chart success with Level Up.

item.title: Delhi Metro sets new record with 82.44 lakh passenger boardings on 17 Sep amid DTC strike; which line saw highest rush?
item.description: Delhi Metro on Thursday recorded its busiest day with 82,44,903 boardings, surpassing the previous day's record of 80,71,630 amid DTC bus strike. Check which line saw the highest rush.

item.title: India rejects Pakistan's allegations over ship collision in Arabian Sea: ‘PNS Hunain conducted in unacceptable manner'
item.description: A collision took place between INS Kolkata and PNS Hunain in the Arabian Sea on Tuesday evening.

item.title: Putin seizes Nestle, French firms’ Russia assets over West's Ukraine support: How big is Nestle’s business there?
item.description: A decree signed by Russian President Vladimir Putin transferred the Russian operations of Nestle, French retailer Auchan, former Leroy Merlin DIY chain — now known as Lemana Pro — and French logistics company FM Logistic to a firm called LEV Management.

item.title: Who is Moninder Singh Pandher? Businessman acquitted in 2006 Nithari killings involving deceased Surendra Koli
item.description: Moninder Singh Pandher, accused in the 2006 Nithari serial killings, was acquitted in October 2023 by the Allahabad High Court. His release gained attention after Surendra Koli, another accused, died by suicide. Pandher has since been largely inactive publicly.

item.title: iPhone langar announced in Chandigarh: 10 lucky people among 1,000 to get iPhone 17 and above, here's the only condition
item.description: Social media personality Rakesh Trehan, aka Raja D King who previously announced ‘petrol langar’, is back with iPhone langar for people of Chandigarh and Mohali. Here's how to win iPhone 17 and above for free.

item.title: ‘Totally unacceptable to us’: India condemns Houthi attacks, flags Red Sea security risks
item.description: India has strongly condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia during a recent briefing, expressing concerns over regional security and freedom of navigation in the Red Sea.&nbsp;

item.title: SC stays high court order striking down provision on income tax reassessment process
item.description: The Centre had earlier told the Supreme Court that the high court ruling had created a “huge vacuum” in the reassessment process of the tax department.

item.title: Pakistan suicide attack: 16 killed, including 5 police personnel, as explosives-laden vehicle hits Kohat police facility
item.description: A suicide attack in Kohat killed at least 16, including five police personnel, during Friday prayers. The attacker used an explosives-laden vehicle. No group has claimed responsibility, while Pakistan's leaders expressed grief and called for medical assistance for the injured.

item.title: Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II: What the $24.3 billion US-Saudi deal means for the Middle East
item.description: The US plans to sell up to 48 F-35 warplanes to Saudi Arabia in a $24.3 billion deal, aimed at bolstering security for a key ally and shaping military dynamics in the Middle East, pending congressional approval.

item.title: India, Nepal seek to ease trade, transit bottlenecks as commerce recovers
item.description: The two countries reviewed market access, customs, border infrastructure and connectivity at a recent bilateral trade meeting.

item.title: SCO trade ministers adopt 2026-30 action plan
item.description: India calls for greater intra-SCO trade, lower trade costs, and more resilient supply chains.

item.title: US targets India with 100% tariffs over Russian oil, but spares uranium: What the sanctions bill says
item.description: US House-passed bill lets Trump impose up to 100% tariffs on countries like India, China buying Russian oil/gas. But Section 114 exempts US-Russia civilian nuclear deals and uranium imports, since Russia supplies ~26% of US reactor enrichment needs, per EIA 2025 data.

item.title: 'We'll come and see': On NEET, SC says will inspect NTA office; seeks report on progress by Nandan Nilekani panel
item.description: NEET exam row: The Centre has told the Supreme Court that the panel has held exhaustive consultations and is likely to submit its first interim report by the end of this month.

item.title: Delhi High Court says payments to overseas units aren't automatically taxable in India
item.description: The dispute involved payments made by Ranbaxy, now merged with Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd, to Teva Israel under a 2011 settlement relating to the US launch of generic atorvastatin.

item.title: Daughter's school bus takes 2 hours to cover 2 km in Bengaluru; parent says 'completely helpless'
item.description: A Bengaluru father’s account of his daughter’s school bus taking two hours to travel just 2 km on the Varthur-Gunjur road has sparked concern online. Other parents have shared similar experiences, calling for safer roads and better traffic management in the city.

item.title: Surendra Koli, acquitted in Nithari serial killing case, dies by suicide, say police
item.description: According to a report, Surendra Koli had been living in a slum in the Bhupatwala area of ​​Haridwar for some time. He earned his living by running a tea stall nearby.

item.title: Sikh truck driver stabbed 17 times in US days after DHS's ‘Mr Singh’ post
item.description: Sikh truck driver stabbed 17 times at a Wyoming rest stop, days after DHS posted an AI-generated graphic mocking a Sikh ‘Mr Singh’. Sikh groups, Hindu American Foundation and Rep. Krishnamoorthi condemned the attack, linking it to rising anti-Sikh profiling concerns.

item.title: Philippines says Chinese ship ‘rammed’ govt boat in South China Sea, Beijing alleges violation of international law
item.description: “The China Coast Guard deliberately rammed a civilian government vessel on a humanitarian and livelihood mission,” the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said.

item.title: Watch: Vicky Kaushal joins iPhone 18 frenzy, poses with Pro Max at Apple BKC
item.description: The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max went on sale in India on September 18, drawing customers to Apple stores across the country. Among the launch-day buyers was actor Vicky Kaushal, who picked up the iPhone 18 Pro Max at Apple BKC in Mumbai.

item.title: Philippines school shooting: 3 killed, 8 injured in South Cotabato
item.description: The incident took place in South ​Cotabato's Banga National High School.

item.title: Laid off at 59 after 3 decades at HP, she found a new career in Antarctica: Her story
item.description: May Lee expected to retire from Hewlett-Packard after three decades at the company. But a layoff at 59, followed by an unsuccessful job search, prompted her to rethink her next move. She eventually took a lower-paying job at McMurdo Station in Antarctica.
